import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

data = """sepal_length,sepal_width,petal_length,petal_width,species
5.1,3.5,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.9,3.0,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.7,3.2,1.3,0.2,setosa
4.6,3.1,1.5,0.2,setosa
5.0,3.6,1.4,0.2,setosa"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset - Setosa Species Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', s=100, color='#2ecc71', ax=axes[0, 0], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].grid(alpha=0.3)

sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='petal_length', y='petal_width', s=100, color='#e74c3c', ax=axes[0, 1], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='measurement', y='value', palette='Set2', ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of All Measurements', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[1, 0].grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

measurement_means = df[['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']].mean()
colors = ['#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#f39c12', '#1abc9c']
axes[1, 1].bar(range(len(measurement_means)), measurement_means.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(len(measurement_means)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(measurement_means.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Measurements', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Value (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
